items.title: How to run an indie game studio: Part 4, Setting (and hitting) quarterly rocks
items.zh_title: 如何经营一家独立游戏工作室（四）：设定并达成季度目标
items.summary: Previously in this series, we've defined your studio purpose , set clear goals for the future , and looked at how to catch and solve the problems that get in the way . This week, we're tackling one of…
items.zh_summary: 本系列此前已讲过如何明确工作室使命、为未来设定清晰目标，以及如何发现并解决路上的问题，本周要聊的是达成目标最关键的工具之一：如何管理必须完成的工作。

items.title: Project Helix reportedly launching in late 2028, projected to cost between $1,200 and $1,800
items.zh_title: 据报道 Project Helix 将于 2028 年底发售，定价 1200 至 1800 美元

items.title: Indies and original IP blew up in 2026
items.zh_title: 2026 年是独立游戏和原创 IP 爆发之年
items.summary: Research by Sensor Tower – done at the request of GamesIndustry.biz – shows that indies and original IP made up a much higher proportion of the biggest PC and console games of 2026 when compared with…
items.zh_summary: Sensor Tower 应 GamesIndustry.biz 之邀所做的研究显示，2026 年最畅销的 PC 和主机游戏中，独立游戏和原创 IP 的占比远高于往年。

items.title: Games like Call of Duty and EA Sports FC most at risk of losing players during GTA 6 launch, according to new data
items.zh_title: 新数据：GTA 6 发售时，《Call of Duty》和《EA Sports FC》这类游戏最容易流失玩家
items.summary: New data shows that competitive shooters and sports games are most at risk of losing players to Grand Theft Auto 6 during its launch next month. Read more
items.zh_summary: 新数据显示，下个月《Grand Theft Auto 6》发售时，竞技射击和体育类游戏最容易被它抢走玩家。

items.title: Vivrato: 97% of studio leaders use AI in some form during development in EU and North America
items.zh_title: Vivrato：欧美 97% 的工作室负责人在开发中以某种形式使用 AI
items.summary: 97% of studio leaders have used AI in some form during development, with 94% having used AI in at least one of the nine production stages. Read more
items.zh_summary: 97% 的工作室负责人曾在开发中以某种形式使用 AI，其中 94% 至少在九个制作环节中的一个用过 AI。

items.title: Demystifying unions: What games leaders need to know
items.zh_title: 破解工会之谜：游戏公司管理者需要知道的事
items.summary: If you run a video games company, working with unions is rapidly becoming an inevitability rather than a possibility. Read more
items.zh_summary: 如果你经营一家游戏公司，与工会打交道正迅速从“可能”变成“必然”。

items.title: ‘Future? No Thanks!’ hilariously rejects future tech
items.zh_title: 《Future? No Thanks!》幽默地拒绝未来科技
items.summary: Future? No Thanks! is a hilarious story-driven open world adventure game where you have aged, to an old, maybe slightly sexist man who is surrounded by the advancements of society. And instead... The…
items.zh_summary: 《Future? No Thanks!》是一款幽默的剧情驱动开放世界冒险游戏，你扮演一位年迈、略带大男子主义的老人，被社会的种种进步包围着，却偏偏要对未来科技说不。

items.title: Rethinking the funnel: where mobile gaming really fits in the marketing mix
items.zh_title: 重新思考漏斗：手游在营销组合中的真实位置
items.summary: Discover why industry leaders are rethinking the marketing funnel. Learn how mobile gaming ads deliver full-funnel results from brand awareness to conversion.
